en_title: How About a GTA Set Outside the United States? 'Never Say Never,' Rockstar Boss Teases, but Don't Hold Your Breath
cn_title: 让《GTA》的故事发生在美国境外如何？Rockstar负责人暗示「永远别说绝不」，但别急着期待
opus_summary: Rockstar North联合负责人Rob Nelson表示，不排除推出以美国以外地区为背景的《GTA》游戏，但美国仍有很多内容可做。Rockstar曾接近制作日本背景作品，首部《GTA》也有伦敦背景扩展内容。《GTA6》将于11月19日发售，带玩家重返罪恶都市。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar isn't ruling out a GTA set outside the United States, but don't hold your breath: the studio says there are plenty more stories to tell in America.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar并未排除制作一款故事发生在美国境外的《GTA》游戏，但别急着期待：工作室表示，美国还有大量故事可讲。

paragraphs.en: In an interview with The Guardian , Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson was asked whether or not the developer would ever make a GTA game set outside of America. His response was simple: "Never say never." However, Nelson continued his response by stating, "There’s still so much to do in America."
paragraphs.cn: 在接受卫报采访时，Rockstar North联合工作室负责人Rob Nelson被问及，开发商是否会制作一款故事发生在美国境外的《GTA》游戏。他的回答很简单：「永远别说绝不。」不过，Nelson接着表示：「在美国还有很多事情可做。」

paragraphs.en: The GTA series has largely rotated between three locations for the last 25 years: Liberty City (New York), Vice City (Miami), and San Andreas (California). We got a brief glimpse at the Midwest of GTA in GTA 5, when the game's story opened in a snowy state called North Yankton. But that's about as much as we've gotten outside of the coastal cities that GTA rotates through. It's unclear what else Rockstar wants to do with GTA, specifically the American setting.
paragraphs.cn: 过去25年来，《GTA》系列的故事主要轮流发生在三个地点：Liberty City（纽约）、Vice City（迈阿密）和San Andreas（加利福尼亚）。在《GTA5》中，我们曾短暂瞥见《GTA》世界里的中西部：游戏故事的开场发生在一个名为North Yankton、白雪皑皑的州。但除了《GTA》轮流采用的沿海城市之外，我们看到的也就差不多这么多了。目前尚不清楚Rockstar还想在《GTA》中做些什么，尤其是在美国背景方面。

paragraphs.en: GTA has flirted with going overseas before, as Rockstar came close to making one set in Japan in the early to mid-2000s . The first GTA also had an expansion set in London, and GTA 5 seemingly had scrapped DLC that would've at least partially taken place in Paris . Ex-GTA writer and creative director Dan Houser also stated last year that he doesn't think GTA would work as well outside of America .
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA》此前曾考虑过走出美国：在2000年代初至中期，Rockstar差点制作一款以日本为背景的作品。首款《GTA》也有一个以伦敦为背景的扩展内容，而《GTA5》似乎曾有一个被取消的DLC，其故事至少部分发生在巴黎。前《GTA》编剧兼创意总监Dan Houser去年也表示，他认为《GTA》如果设定在美国境外，效果不会那么好。

paragraphs.en: "I think for a full GTA game, we always decided there was so much Americana inherent in the IP, it would be really hard to make it work in London or anywhere else," said Houser. "You know, you needed guns, you needed these larger-than-life characters. It just felt like the game was so much about America, possibly from an outsider's perspective. But that was so much about what the thing was that it wouldn't really have worked in the same way elsewhere.”
paragraphs.cn: Houser说：「我认为，对于一款完整的《GTA》游戏，我们一直认定这个IP本身包含了太多美国文化元素，因此要让它在伦敦或其他任何地方行得通会非常困难。你知道，你需要枪支，需要这些极具传奇色彩的角色。感觉这款游戏的很大一部分就是关于美国的，也许是从一个局外人的视角来看待美国。但那在很大程度上构成了这款游戏的本质，所以它放在别的地方就无法以同样的方式发挥作用。」

paragraphs.en: Maybe one day it will happen, but it does seem like Rockstar's interests with GTA are rooted in American culture.
paragraphs.cn: 也许有一天这会成为现实，但Rockstar对《GTA》的兴趣似乎确实植根于美国文化。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will, of course, take us back to Vice City next week when it launches on November 19. It is expected to have one of the biggest launches in history, with it already being the most preordered game in the history of Xbox and PlayStation's digital stores . Players are able to preload the game right now , and they absolutely should, as the game is a whopping 210 GBs.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，《GTA6》将于下周11月19日发售，届时会带我们重返Vice City。预计它将迎来史上规模最大的首发之一，目前它已经是XBOX和PlayStation数字商店历史上预购量最高的游戏。玩家现在就可以预载游戏，而且绝对应该这么做，因为游戏容量高达210 GB。
